people.allowed: public figures, everyday people, user-uploaded personal portraits, and social-media photos for clean studio portraits, thumbnails, posters, and background edits.
blocked: anyone under 18 in unsafe, sexual, or exploitative contexts
fraudulent impersonation / deceptive fake news endorsements
non-consensual doxxing or identifying private strangers from photos

contentRules: Never invent prices, discounts, statistics, dates, names or quotes that the user did not supply.
Preserve the identity of user-uploaded subjects when editing portraits or scenes.
Do not put real people's photos into misleading defamatory contexts (fake news, fraudulent endorsements).
Web photos are third-party property: keep source domain metadata only for internal attribution.
